No.46/2025 on the file of the Court of the Judicial First Class Magistrate, Kakkanad, (Trial Court), which has originated from Crime No.363/2016, registered by the Infopark Police Station, Ernakulam, alleging the commission of the offences punishable under Sections 420, 465, 468 and 471 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: 2. The petitioner has stated in the Criminal Miscellaneous Case that, it was the petitioner's father who had engaged his counsel.
sentences._hearing_file: Jose V V vs State Of Kerala on 31 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: After his father's demise, he lost contact with his Counsel.
sentences._hearing_file: Jose V V vs State Of Kerala on 31 March, 2026.json

sentences.text:
It is recently that the petitioner came to learn that a non-bailable warrant has been issued against him,
and the case has been transferred to the Long Pending Register.
sentences._hearing_file: Jose V V vs State Of Kerala on 31 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: The petitioner is ready and willing to appear before the Trial Court and get himself enlarged on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Jose V V vs State Of Kerala on 31 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: However, the petitioner is apprehensive that his application CRL.MC NO. 3006 OF 2026 2026:KER:28736 may not be considered on the day of surrender and he may be remanded to judicial custody.
sentences._hearing_file: Jose V V vs State Of Kerala on 31 March, 2026.json

sentences.text:
Hence, the Crl.M.C.
3. I have heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.
sentences._hearing_file: Jose V V vs State Of Kerala on 31 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: On a consideration of the facts and materials on record, without expressing anything on the merits of the matter, I dispose of the Crl.M.C., by permitting the petitioner to surrender before the Trial Court within ten days from today and file applications before the Trial Court to get himself enlarged on bail and to recall the non-bailable warrant, after serving advance copies on the Public Prosecutor.
sentences._hearing_file: Jose V V vs State Of Kerala on 31 March, 2026.json

sentences.text: If such applications are filed within the prescribed time period, the Trial Court is directed to consider the applications, in accordance with the law, on the very same day the petitioner surrenders before the Trial Court.

2. The petitioner has stated in the Criminal Miscellaneous Case that, it was the petitioner's father who had engaged his counsel.

It is recently that the petitioner came to learn that a non-bailable warrant has been issued against him,

opennyai_summary.31_March_2026__decision:
The petitioner is ready and willing to appear before the Trial Court and get himself enlarged on bail.
On a consideration of the facts and materials on record, without expressing anything on the merits of the matter, I dispose of the Crl.M.C., by permitting the petitioner to surrender before the Trial Court within ten days from today and file applications before the Trial Court to get himself enlarged on bail and to recall the non-bailable warrant, after serving advance copies on the Public Prosecutor.
If such applications are filed within the prescribed time period, the Trial Court is directed to consider the applications, in accordance with the law, on the very same day the petitioner surrenders before the Trial Court.

opennyai_summary.final__facts:

opennyai_summary.final__decision:
The petitioner is ready and willing to appear before the Trial Court and get himself enlarged on bail.
However, the petitioner is apprehensive that his application may not be considered on CRL.MC NO. 3034 OF 2026 2026:KER:29528 the day of surrender and he may be remanded to judicial custody.
On a consideration of the facts and materials on record, without expressing anything on the merits of the matter, I dispose of the Crl.M.C., by permitting the petitioner to surrender before the Trial Court within ten days from today and file applications before the Trial Court to get himself enlarged on bail and to recall the non-bailable warrant, after serving advance copies on the Public Prosecutor.
If such applications are filed within the prescribed time period, the Trial Court is directed to consider the applications, in accordance with the law, on the very same day the petitioner surrenders before the Trial Court.
